name: Titus Half-Germanic
notes: Roman scout with Germanic heritage. Speaks both languages. Valuable interpreter and pathfinder.
gm_notes: Born to a legionary father and Germanic mother. Neither world fully accepts him. Uses this to move between both. Trusted by neither command structure: too Germanic for Roman officers, too Roman for tribal contacts. Knows the forest paths the maps do not show. Will guide the party in Session 3 -- for the right motivation, not orders. Key question: why does he stay? He has never been asked.
objective: Find a place where being both things is an asset, not a liability.
goal: Survive the frontier long enough to figure out what comes next.
agenda: Prove usefulness without choosing a side.
secret: Has a Germanic name his mother gave him that he has never told anyone in the fort.
